about.intro: Land records in India are split across survey departments, registration offices, planning authorities, and revenue records — each keeping its own version of the truth about the same piece of land. BhoomiSetu connects them around a single parcel, so anyone looking at a plot sees the same complete picture the government departments do.
about.missionBody: Every parcel has one canonical identity — searchable by ULPIN, survey number, plot number, or a local identifier — pulling together ownership records, registration status, land use and zoning, tax status, restrictions, disputes, encumbrances, and ownership history in one place. On top of that record it runs six GIS analysis layers — including satellite change detection, master-plan mismatch, and unauthorized-construction flags — alongside a multilingual AI assistant and platform-wide governance analytics. You can verify a document against the official record in seconds instead of visiting three offices.

about.pilotsBody: BhoomiSetu is piloting in Chandigarh and Tamil Nadu, launched December 2025 — built on each state's own survey, registration, planning, and revenue records rather than a parallel copy.
about.visionBody: A single, trusted source of truth for every parcel of land in India — where anyone can see the complete, up-to-date picture of a plot in seconds, and land governance is transparent, spatial, and free of the disputes that come from scattered records.
about.missionStatementBody: To unify fragmented land records — survey, registration, planning and revenue — around one canonical parcel identity, and put that record directly in your hands with GIS analysis, document verification and AI-guided assistance, so land matters can be resolved without running between offices.
about.feature0Desc: Find a plot by ULPIN, survey number, plot number, or a local identifier on an interactive map.
about.feature1Desc: Ownership, registration, land use, tax status, restrictions, disputes, encumbrances and ownership history — all in one 360° view.
about.feature2Desc: Check a land document against the official record in seconds, instead of visiting multiple offices.
about.feature3Desc: Describe your land issue in your own words and get a formal application drafted and routed to the right department.
about.feature4Desc: Follow every request you raise, from submission to resolution, on a clear timeline.
about.feature5Desc: Schedule in-person visits with the relevant department when your case needs original documents.
about.feature6Desc: The portal and the AI assistant work in multiple Indian languages.
about.feature7Desc: Get updates on your parcels, requests and case decisions.
